feedback.text: Owner answers to your five questions. (1) Notice v1 approved as drafted (round 7 q2); the legal name, policy URL and rights email stay as visible placeholders; Sempertex legal reviews before real users are invited. (2) Yes: the administrator can generate a new invitation link for an invited account (and a new reset link); the new link invalidates every older unused link of the same kind; show «Generar enlace nuevo» on invited accounts and explain that older links stop working. (3) Deletion: an account with saved work (projects or decorations) cannot be deleted, only deactivated; the delete action is available only for accounts without saved work and otherwise explains why and offers Deactivate; AI spend is kept without personal data as «Cuenta eliminada»; deletion still requires typing the email. (4) Custom roles need at least one permission. (5) Activation signs the person in directly and takes them to the first tool their role allows; no extra sign-in step.

Planner rulings on Q6-Q8 (plan updated): Q6 no distinct locked message: one generic refusal for wrong password, unknown email, deactivated and locked; every failure message adds the neutral hint that after several failures one must wait fifteen minutes; remove the locked-state fixture. Q7 own-password change keeps the requesting browser signed in (the service ends all sessions and the route opens a new one), other browsers are signed out; say so in the success message; admin resets end all sessions. Q8 post-login fallback: /cuenta when the role has none of Taller 3D, chat or catalogue. Q1: the bracketed notice fields are a pending owner input tracked in SPEC Inputs; keep them as visible placeholders and do not ask again.

Visual redesign requested by the owner: keep the contract's behavior, views, states and criteria, but rebuild the mockup's visual layer applying agents/designer/references/mockup-craft.md in full (the earlier pass only patched details). Per screen: name its one question and main job first, colour on data and the one primary action only, flat neutral surfaces, no generator tells, right-aligned tabular figures, product words in labels and empty states. The project's real design tokens win. Render and look at it before reporting.

Rebuild the mockup on the david-ui stand-in kit, as the owner asked: read agents/designer/skills/david-ui-kit/SKILL.md and compose every screen from the kit's snippets (kit/components/*), inline the kit with kit/inline.py, keep the view/state/scene/theme selects, keep the contract's behavior, views, states and criteria. Then run kit/audit_mockup.py and fix what it reports until it passes (or say AUDIT NOT RUN). Owner complaints to resolve: off-centre blocks (footer on another x than a centred form), cramped padding, dark-theme contrast incl. control edges and native checkboxes.

Owner verdict on round 1 (all three contracts): the directions differ in structure, but they share the same purple-on-near-white look and calm motion, which reads as a safe SaaS default. Redo EVERY direction as a distinct visual world, taking real risks: (1) its own colour logic and palette per direction (no shared accent across A/B/C, not the Pictures purple by default; avoid cream+terracotta, purple gradients, acid-green-on-black); (2) its own type pairing with character per direction (different families, a display face with personality, scale used expressively); (3) its own shape, material and texture language (derived from the product world: Sempertex balloons, event decoration, tactility, inflatable/foil/latex, party light; not generic cards); (4) motion as a first-class part of the design: page-load choreography, view-to-view transitions, hover/press/focus micro-interactions, state-change transitions, ambient or scroll motion, at least six distinct animated behaviours per direction, each direction with its own motion language (easing family, timing, choreography), expressive profile by default, full prefers-reduced-motion degradation and AA contrast mid-animation. Do not carry over round-1 structure unless it earns its place; the previous round stays in history. Use the anti-slop guidance and direction library in the kit (huashu-style six-thumbnails-to-three, emil-kowalski motion craft, taste/impeccable tells). The mockups must still pass kit/audit_mockup.py and compare_directions.py.

Visual redesign requested by the owner: keep the contract's behavior, views, states and criteria, but rebuild the mockup's visual layer applying agents/designer/references/mockup-craft.md in full (the earlier pass only patched details). Per screen: name its one question and main job first, colour on data and the one primary action only, flat neutral surfaces, no generator tells, right-aligned tabular figures, product words in labels and empty states. The project's real design tokens win. Render and look at it before reporting.

Rebuild the mockup on the david-ui stand-in kit, as the owner asked: read agents/designer/skills/david-ui-kit/SKILL.md and compose every screen from the kit's snippets (kit/components/*), inline the kit with kit/inline.py, keep the view/state/scene/theme selects, keep the contract's behavior, views, states and criteria. Owner verdict on round 1 (all three contracts): the directions differ in structure, but they share the same purple-on-near-white look and calm motion, which reads as a safe SaaS default. Redo EVERY direction as a distinct visual world, taking real risks: (1) its own colour logic and palette per direction (no shared accent across A/B/C, not the Pictures purple by default; avoid cream+terracotta, purple gradients, acid-green-on-black); (2) its own type pairing with character per direction (different families, a display face with personality, scale used expressively); (3) its own shape, material and texture language (derived from the product world: Sempertex balloons, event decoration, tactility, inflatable/foil/latex, party light; not generic cards); (4) motion as a first-class part of the design: page-load choreography, view-to-view transitions, hover/press/focus micro-interactions, state-change transitions, ambient or scroll motion, at least six distinct animated behaviours per direction, each direction with its own motion language (easing family, timing, choreography), expressive profile by default, full prefers-reduced-motion degradation and AA contrast mid-animation. Do not carry over round-1 structure unless it earns its place; the previous round stays in history. Use the anti-slop guidance and direction library in the kit (huashu-style six-thumbnails-to-three, emil-kowalski motion craft, taste/impeccable tells). The mockups must still pass kit/audit_mockup.py and compare_directions.py.
